record.paper_title: Some Open Problems and Conjectures Associated with the Invariant Subspace Problem
record.original_question: Let X be an infinite-dimensional separable real Banach space and let T:X -> X be a continuous operator with no non-trivial closed invariant subspaces. Let X_c be the complexification of X and let T_c:X_c -> X_c be the natural complex-linear extension T_c(x + iy) = T x + i T y. Is it true that T_c also has no non-trivial closed invariant subspaces?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be an infinite-dimensional separable real Banach space, and let $T:X\to X$ be a bounded linear operator. Define the complexification $X_c := X\oplus X$ equipped with the complex scalar multiplication $(a+ib)(x,y) := (ax-by,\,ay+bx)$ for $a,b\in\mathbb{R}$, $x,y\in X$, written symbolically as $x+iy$, and endowed with a norm (e.g., the Taylor norm) making it a complex Banach space. Let $T_c:X_c\to X_c$ be the complex-linear extension defined by
$$T_c(x+iy) := Tx + iTy.$$
A closed subspace $M\subseteq X_c$ is called non-trivial invariant for $T_c$ if $\{0\}\neq M\neq X_c$ and $T_c(M)\subseteq M$.

Suppose that $T$ has no non-trivial closed invariant subspace in $X$. Must it then be true that $T_c$ also has no non-trivial closed invariant subspace in $X_c$?
artifact.status_search_result: Searches indicate this question (relating invariant subspaces of a real operator without nontrivial invariant subspaces and those of its complexification) is regarded as an open conjecture in the literature on the invariant subspace problem for real Banach spaces. No published resolution was located.

status_evidence.title: Some Open Problems and Conjectures Associated with the Invariant Subspace Problem
status_evidence.snippet: Lists open problems and conjectures concerning invariant subspaces, including the relation between real operators and their complexifications.
status_evidence.claim: The question is posed as an open conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Similarities and differences between real and complex Banach spaces: an overview
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses subtle differences between invariant subspace results in real vs. complex Banach spaces and notes no general connection is known between invariant subspaces of a real operator and its complexifications.
status_evidence.claim: The relation remains unresolved in the literature.
